opening: I went to the pantry in my hall. The fire alarm rang. What happened?
answer: I went to smoke cigarettes with my friends but we forget to open the windows and turn on the exhaust fan. Due to the poor ventilation, we accidentally triggered the fire alarm. (Disclaimer: this puzzle is NOT based on any real incidents)
